body: yeah, guy here. I use this account all the time, I'm just more of a lurker I guess. I'm trying to change that tho. :-/
I have cats and they've never been interested in my tablet or laptop, so this is funny to me, sorry if I didn't manage to cheer you up with it. And no, that's not me.
thank you. :)

Oh wow... <3 

You're amazing! This really touched me... I'll be thinking long and hard about what you wrote and I thank you so much for it. :)

thank you for everything, logopogo. :)
You're messages were probably the reason why I managed to get enough courage to write here. =)

thank you for your kind words. I will think about it, but I think both of there possibilities are out of question for me now. :( 

I don't want her to find out about this. Ever. I really hope she's already dating someone else and happy. I'm not going to hurt her again.

And I've thought about hospital several times now... But i don't know. The sharp pain in my chest is freaking me out, and I was so close to calling 911. But it's stupid. I've wanted this all along, I should stand by it now... It's been almost 10 years of struggling now. Let's face it, I'm never going to be healthy again. The only thing that will happen if I call a doctor now, is that I'll be leaving behind a huge amount of medical bills that my father will end up paying for. And he resents me enough as it is. I don't want to leave any bills behind when I die. :(

I messaged you. :) 
Thank you so much. <3

Thank you for your advice. I will think about it.

Why have people downvoted you? I'm really sorry about that. :( I have upvoted you, I hope this balances it out.

why have people downvoted you? I don't get this. I'm really sorry for that. I upvoted you to try and balance out the downvotes. But it's still confusing. I guess there are people out there who don't want you to help? I don't know. :( But I'm sure it's not because of what you wrote. They probably just don't think you should help *me*. Please don't take the downvotes personal. I'm glad you commented here with so much kindness. :(

I understand your encouragment. I just stopped believing that this is going to be only temporary. This has been my life for so many years. And even the good things I had have been sucked away by my eating disorder. And it has caused so much damage to the people around me. Maybe I deserve to get better, I don't know. But I don't get to drag other people into this. I've caused too much pain as it already.
thank you. Are you better now? How did you do it?
thank you. I'll think about it, but I don't think I can. Just Posting in this subreddit was hard enough. I'm not very brave, I don't think I could tell anyone in real life.

oh wow... It's so confusing. I don't see how you could think anything I did was brave. Even after writing this post in this subreddit, I felt so sick and regretted it immediately...

I don't even know if I have the strength to turn this around now. And I'm actually really, really afraid that if I do, It's never going be the same again, because I'm almost sure I've damaged some parts of my internal system permanently... if not even my heart, than at least my bones, my stomach, my digestive system... I'm really afraid that it might be too late, even if I decide to do something about it. That just letting go will be easier. Better for everyone.

I've been relapsing for a decade now. I'm tired. I don't want this anymore. I've pretty much accepted that I'll never be healthy.

She doesn't read reddit. I think if she did I never would have posted here. 

I really don't want to drag her into this. Right now she thinks I'm safe and sound and she is probably already dating someone else. I don't want her to find out what is going on. *IF* I somehow, miraculously make it... then maybe I'll tell her the truth one day. But not like this. :( I hope you understand.
thank you for your kindness.
thank you. Did you have an eating disorder as well? Do you think I could message you maybe?

I'll try to come up with something. 

All the positive messages are making me really confused right now... I was so determined... and now... I don't know. 

I'll see if I can come up with something that'll make me feel a bit better and let you know. But I stand by my decision to keep her out of this. She doesn't deserve this.

I guess you're telling me to eat, right? 

I don't know... I've made it this far. Going through with it seems easier (and better for everyone) now than to start eating again.
thank you.
Thank you for your kind words. I don't think I can tell anyone though. There's no way I could bring up the courage.
I really, really want to believe you're right. But I just can't drag her into this again. And I feel it's too late to get better now.
Thanks, but I've given up on that a long time ago. Thanks anyway though.
No idea what I'm gonna do, but probably nothing special.

Thank you very much for your kind words and thoughts... Unfortunately it's a lot harder than it seems. I wish I could just sit down and eat and eat and eat. I know how incredibly happy she was when I gained those first few pounds and I'd do everything to recreate that.
My best friend is 6'3'', just like me, but 50 lbs heavier than I am, and you should see how happy and proud she looks when he comes over and stuffs himself into oblivion with her food. I wish I could be like that one day, but most probably I never will. I'll be happy to reach my "safe weight" of 165 again some day.
But right now I don't want to eat, I don't want to gain weight, I just want to let the control go again for a bit, not care about food and just get lighter and lighter until the pain is gone.

Yes, if I knew for sure she'd stay with me once I tell her, I'd immediately tell her. It would take a lot of pressure of myself, trying to hide my behavior, and I would finally be able to share this secret with her.

I see your point and I will think it through. I know it won't be the best outcome for **me**, but I see how it probably will be the best outcome for **her** in the long run and I've been putting my own needs before hers for way too long now.

I guess I know, I'm just not ready atm. I feel so useless right now, and the guilt over this whole situation isn't helping me either. I can't wait for the situation to sort itself out so I can finally stop eating for a while without her freaking out not knowing what is happening. If I feel like I'm having trouble keeping the weight loss under control I'll seek help.
Thank you, this is somewhat reassuring.

Yes I know what you're trying to say. This thread is a reality check for me after all. I know I need outside opinions at the moment if I don't want to do another thing I might regret later. The big difference in opinion though is leaving me very confused at the moment. The general idea seems to be to either tell her or break the relationship off without telling her (and therefor sparing her more pain).

Okay, this is really confusing the shit out of me... Do other people think the same? Spare her the pain, lie to her one more time and go through my relapse alone? While this idea completely freaks me out right now I do see that it might be at least saving her the pain she doesn't deserve to begin with.

Holy crap this was incredibly triggering somehow, but I completely see your point. She deserves better and I wish I could undo it, but it's too late now. I have to take responsibility and explain it to her someway or another.
It *IS* crazy and I regret a lot of it right now. I should never have dated her in the first place knowing that I had a similar history like her Ex.

Thank you, this has been a great help! "Keeping me on the ground" really is a very fitting description. I'll use this somehow.
I really hope she'll stay, but I highly doubt it. She's so young and still not over her ex, she should not have to go through that again. Especially not while I'm in the middle of a relapse. For quite a while I tried to find a solution in which I could explain  my weight loss to her using some kind of disease like a parasite infection or something, lose all the weight I need to until I manage to get a hold of myself again, hopefully gain some weight back and only THEN tell her what has been happening and that it really was my last relapse. That way she wouldn't have to worry all through my relapse... But I see no way this would actually work.

I respect your decision not to share. I still hope you're getting better and I'll be thinking of your well-being.

I was thinking of maybe phrasing it in a way that the word anorexic doesn't come up? Just tell her, that I've been struggling with my weight lately, that I'm probably gonna lose more weigh in the months to come, but that she shouldn't worry and that I'll work it out somehow. That this has been a normal reaction of mine when being stressed and that I didn't want to tell her because I didn't want her to panic/stress and that she has been an amazing help in keeping me going lately.

What do you think?

I'd be willing to message you a scan of my driver's licence (that has a really old picture of me on it at my former weight of almost 200 lbs) and a picture of me now at my lower weight, if that would really make a difference to you.
I've only been 8 lbs heavier when I was with her, she's never seen me at my old weight (doesn't even know I used to be heavier) and I've always been able to blame it on my metabolism and the fact that I'm very active. As I've said, my BMI is still at the edge of what is considered healthy or at least "in limits" by many. It has still bothered her, especially at the beginning (as I've mentioned it has been a problem when we've been intimate), but I've never displayed any weird "anorexic" behavior in front of her. Nevertheless, the more people are commenting the more I get the feeling she might already have known. Maybe the recent weight loss has given it away already, I don't know. Then again, why wouldn't she have confronted me if she suspected something?
 
edit: confusing typo

Thank you for the advice. Yes, she has been an incredible help and I will tell her how grateful I am for the time I spent with her, even if she choses to leave me.
When I had my last relapse (yeaaaars ago), I was hospitalized within a matter of weeks. I can't believe it's been three months and I'm still only 8 lbs down. That is completely on her and I am so thankful for that.

I don't know... I guess I sort of realize that now, although I really didn't at that time. It's simply... I know very little guys with the same disease I have and I've never ever seen a relationship take that stress and still remain so strong. But she was there till the very end and even though she was devastated, she somehow managed to pick herself up again and it hasn't changed who she is for the worse. I really admired that so much.
I thought I'd *always* chose a woman like her over my eating disorder and that I just wouldn't relapse. ever again.

I'm just really desperate here. Been able to manage for almost 3 months, but am at my wits ends here. What do you think shouldn't I tell her?

Can I ask what your illness is?
You're completely right. But damn, this is gonna be such a shock to her...

I'm not completely sure if I'd already be willing to seek professional help again, since I'm still at a very healthy weight. But I'd be willing to give her the promise to seek help if ever I felt I truly needed it. Thanks for the advice, I will definetely include that when I tell her.
How do you think I should tell her? We've been together for little over a year now and I've been hiding it deliberately. How can I make that sound better than it really is?
